reviews.text: I would not take or trust my dog with anyone else except Adorable Grooms.  We have been a client for 4 years. Everyone on the staff is courteous, professional and friendly.  They take such good care of her.  And their work is wonderful.  I recommend the highly.

I’ve always had a great experience at Adorable Grooms.  They treat my dogs with so much care, and the grooming always turns out beautifully.  One of my dogs is a very anxious rescue, and the team has been incredibly patient with him.  He gets more comfortable with each visit, and every staff member has been consistently kind and gentle.  I highly recommend Adorable Grooms to anyone looking for a trustworthy, compassionate groomer.
They are friendly and do a very good job
Our Zoey loves coming here and we always have a great experience! Thank you Adorable Grooms, we recommend you to all of our friends

Update: owner does not listen to her customers and is not friendly. I absolutely do not recommend this place to anyone. I definitely do not want to come back and I already said in my original review below the place I take my dog which has far better customer service and are better with handling dogs. I have left other groomers 5 star reviews such as Lizzy's Pet Grooming in Fort Worth and Camp Bow Wow but not Adorable Grooms due to poor service issues.

The last appointment I had, a lady showed me a bag of my dog's fur. I didn't ask to see a bag of trash so I was taken a back. I emailed Tye and she said that it is what they show for those that pay for deshedding...  I have been taking my dog there for almost a year and that was the first time anyone showed me a bag of trash. This practice was never communicated to either myself nor my husband. I was willing to let it go and emailed the next month for a another appointment but got no response. Adorable grooms is the only groomer we have been to that fail to trim his nails. I went to camp bow wow to groom my dog and they had no problems trimming his nails and suggested that adorable grooms may have been too rough with my dog because they were able to trim his nails just fine with one person. Adorable grooms made me or my husband as customers to hold our dog while they clip his nails. No groomer ever made us help trim the nails because we're are the ones paying for the service.
They are so kind and sweet with our dog, I highly recommend them. They do a great job and have great prices.

We have been going here for 10 years for our Cavalier pups. I brought in my new baby Tilly for her first grooming ever, and they took such good care of her. Before this appointment, she hated for the blow dryer to be anywhere near her ears- it really scared her. I just gave her a bath and blow dry a couple weeks post appointment- and Tye - you and your team are so amazing because she let me blow dry her ears with ease!!! Goes to show you how great Adorable Grooms is at their job. Thank you again for treating Tilly and Henry with such love and care❤️

We have been using Adorable Grooms for over 12 years and we love Tye and the other groomers.  They are very professional and caring when it comes to your pet.  They have great communication and are very helpful if you need anything.  I would 10/10 recommend them to anyone!

I’m a potential new client so I went to the salon to see the setup and discuss my pups grooming.  I reviewed the website and it showed open until 6pm today, and although a grooming appointment is needed, there are specific walk in services and prices listed.  I arrived at 5:25 and the place was dark and closed.  In addition, there is a sign on the door that says No Walk Ins.  Guess the hours of operation and walk in services need to be modified on the website.
The ladies here were very welcoming and loving towards my dog. They also exceeded my expectations with the haircut! I will definitely be back.
We love Adorable Grooms! Great value for the price and our dog always looks very cute when we pick him up.

I have been taking my dog Max here since a wee pup.  They were great with him. They treated him like their own. Very important to this dog parent.  I take him usually looking well a mess and when I get him he looks like a perfect gentleman!  Below is Max before the second Max after. Wonderful. I recommend this group highly. Catriona

As many five star reviews as they have, there is an underlying attitude. I was told by the owner after I called about the time it took to prepare my puppy, Four hours that if I didn’t like how long they took that I should find another groomer, not the best attitude to promote your business. After a follow up with the owner and a conversation, they’re still an attitude. It’s her way all the highway if you go there, be prepared for the attitude.
